ResearchProjectDef.label: qi-tempered arms
ResearchProjectDef.description:
Since the qi came back, a cultivator can shrug off a rifle round like a mosquito bite. The smiths who survived the first years learned why: a mortal blade has no qi to bite with. Quench the steel in water where spirit stones have soaked, chant the old tempering count, and even a bolt-action rifle remembers how to wound an immortal.
All weapons and turrets reach spirit grade 1. Weapons made of a spirit material add its grade on top.
